title: SDE 2 - Data & Reporting
function: Backend Development, Big Data / DWH / ETL
skills: Databricks, backend, Spark, Apache Spark, data
description_text:
We are looking for a highly motivated Software Development Engineer II (SDE II) - Data and Reporting to join our growing technology team. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy working at the intersection of data engineering, backend development, and analytics, transforming raw data into actionable insights that drive key business decisions. You will be responsible for building scalable data pipelines, integrating multiple data sources, and enabling reporting solutions that support functions such as Sales, Revenue, Billing, Traffic Analysis, User Engagement, and Business Operations.
Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Apache Spark (Scala/PySpark) and Databricks.
Build and manage data processing workflows to support reporting and analytics requirements.
Work with both structured and unstructured datasets to create and maintain curated data layers (Bronze, Silver, Gold architecture).
Develop integrations with internal services, APIs, and third-party data sources for data ingestion and transformation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver business reports and dashboards using BigQuery, Looker, or similar BI tools.
Partner with engineering and business stakeholders to improve data quality, reliability, lineage, and performance.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data inconsistencies and reporting issues.
Ensure timely and accurate delivery of critical business insights and operational reports.
Requirements:
3+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Backend Engineering, or a related role.
Strong programming skills in Scala, Python, and/or Java.
Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and Databricks.
Good understanding of large-scale data processing and distributed computing.
Experience with Google BigQuery, Looker, or other business intelligence/reporting platforms.
Knowledge of backend development concepts, including RESTful APIs, Java/Python-based services, MySQL/PostgreSQL databases
Experience building batch and near real-time data pipelines on cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

title: Junior Backend Engineer
skills: Microservices, Java, TCP, Python, Data Structures, Algorithms, Kafka, UDP
description_text:
We are building a communication platform that handles millions of concurrent connections and delivers messages in milliseconds. As a Backend Engineer, you won't just be building features; you'll be optimizing the pipes that keep the massively scalable messaging running. You will work on massive-scale socket management, encryption protocols, and globally distributed databases.
Responsibilities:
API Design: Build and document performant, secure APIs that power our mobile and web applications.
System Design: Design systems that scale to millions of users messaging each other simultaneously.
Network optimizations: Ensure maximum network throughput by optimizing every packet that gets transferred through the network.
Data Reliability: Optimize database queries and schema designs for lightning-fast message retrieval and archival.
System Monitoring: Deploy and monitor microservices using automated pipelines, ensuring "five nines" (99.999%) uptime.
Requirements:
Computer Science Enthusiast: You have a solid grasp of CS fundamentalsData Structures, Algorithms, and Operating Systems.
Network Savvy: You understand how the Load Balancers, reverse/forward proxy, and CDN actually work.
Curious and Scrappy: You have a GitHub full of side projects or a history of breaking (and fixing) things.
Performance Obsessed: You hate bloat and constantly keep optimizing and simplifying even if not asked.
The Tech Stack:
Languages: Java, Python (we prioritize strong understanding and experience in multi-threading).
Infrastructure: Distributed systems and Linux-based environments.
Data: MySql or Postgres and NoSQL (e. g., MongoDB and HBase/BigTable) and Redis (caching).
Bonus Points:
Experience with gRPC.
Contributions to open-source projects.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer
skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, AWS CloudFormation, Node.js, Express.js, Next.js
description_text:
We are seeking a Backend and Platform Engineer to play a pivotal role in building our Low-Code platform. As the first platform engineer on the team, you will have the unique opportunity to shape the technical direction of the company and design and develop the platform from scratch. You will also get to collaborate with other software functions and to build some of the coolest engineering in health.
Responsibilities:
System Architecture: HealthBlox seeks to leverage a plug-and-play approach to deploy health tools. Strong design and architectural creativity are a must in such an environment.
Product Development: Contribute to product ideation and innovation and work with customers and industry experts to iterate and build products that everyone would love.
Coding and Implementation: Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code while following best practices for software development.
Technical Creativity: Lead the development of our platform from the ground up, making critical technical decisions that align with the company's vision and objectives. Navigating ambiguities should be bread and butter.
Testing and Quality Assurance: Develop and implement thorough testing protocols to ensure the reliability, safety, and compliance with industry regulations. Debug and resolve software issues as they arise.
Team Building: As an early engineer, you will have the opportunity to build and mentor a team of software engineers as the company expands.
Requirements:
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Full-stack development experience, with a focus on backend technologies (80/20 split).
We mostly write in Node.js but are flexible in our approach.
In-depth knowledge of AWS/other cloud platforms.
Exposure to or willingness to learn event-driven software architecture and serverless programming and orchestration.
Ideal candidate has exposure to FHIR (if not, you can pick this up on the job).
Experience in healthcare or medical technology is a plus.
Exposure to Terraform is a plus.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
A sense of silly idealism in wanting to make the world a better place.

description_text:
We're hiring a Software Engineer II to help build and scale the core platform behind AiPrise's compliance orchestration and AI agent systems. This is a build it, ship it, own it role. You'll take features end to end, from design to code to deploy to iterate, across our case management product, vendor integrations, orchestration APIs, and customer-facing tools. You'll be in the trenches with founders and a fast-moving team, turning messy real-world compliance problems into clean, reliable systems. If you're a hungry engineer who wants real ownership, high impact, and a product that gets used in production every day, you'll love this. This is an in-person role based in our San Jose, CA office (5 days/week). You'll work directly with our product and engineering teams to deliver high-quality features that help global fintechs fight financial crime. As an SDE2 you'll mentor junior engineers and help establish engineering best practices.
The core responsibilities for the job include the following:
Build and Own Features End-to-End:
Design, develop, and ship production features across our platform stack (backend APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and case management UI).
Own complete features from requirements gathering to implementation, deployment, and monitoring.
Build scalable REST APIs and microservices that orchestrate checks across 80+ compliance vendors (identity verification, sanctions screening, and document analysis).
Develop case management workflows and business logic for KYB/AML compliance processes.
Create data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and routing compliance data at scale.
Integrate with third-party identity/compliance APIs and handle complex vendor response mapping.
Drive Technical Excellence:
Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code with comprehensive documentation.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
Debug production issues with urgency; own incident resolution end-to-end.
Optimize system performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency.
Build monitoring, alerting, and observability into your features.
Collaborate:
Work cross-functionally with product managers, compliance experts, and customer success teams.
Contribute to technical decision-making and architecture discussions.
Help shape engineering culture and development workflows as the team scales.
Requirements:
2-4 years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.
Strong programming fundamentals in at least one modern backend language (Python, Go, Java, Node.js, or similar).
Experience building RESTful APIs, microservices, or distributed systems.
Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and data modeling.
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred, GCP/Azure acceptable).
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and modern deployment practices.
Proven ability to own features end-to-end; you've taken projects from ambiguous requirements through production launch.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills; comfortable working in unfamiliar codebases.
Excellent communication skills and ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
Experience mentoring or supporting junior engineers (formal or informal).
Nice-to-Have:
Experience in FinTech, RegTech, payments, or fraud/risk detection domains.
Knowledge of compliance workflows (KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, adverse media).
Experience with event-driven architectures and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS).
Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB) or search engines (Elasticsearch).
Experience integrating with third-party APIs and managing vendor relationships at scale.
Frontend development experience (React, TypeScript) for building internal tools.
Background working with ML/AI systems or data-intensive applications.
Kubernetes, Terraform, or infrastructure-as-code experience.

title: Backend Engineer
skills: APIs, SQL, Python, Data Structures, Django
description_text:
We're hiring a Backend Engineer to join our engineering team and help build the systems that power Everest Fleet's platform. You'll work on REST APIs, data pipelines, and infrastructure integrations, contributing to features that directly impact drivers, fleet operators, and enterprise clients. This is a great opportunity to work on backend systems at real-world scale, with a modern Python/Django stack on AWS.
Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain RESTful APIs used by our web and mobile frontends.
Write backend logic in Python using the Django / Django REST Framework stack.
Work with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), write optimized queries, design schemas, and handle migrations.
Integrate third-party services and APIs (payment gateways, communication platforms, mapping services).
Contribute to infrastructure setup and deployments on AWS (EC2 RDS, S3 Lambda).
Write unit tests and participate in code reviews to uphold code quality.
Debug production issues, interpret logs, and resolve incidents.
Collaborate with frontend engineers and product stakeholders to deliver end-to-end features.
Requirements:
1-2 years of professional backend development experience.
Solid Python fundamentals: data structures, OOP, error handling, and async patterns.
Hands-on experience with Django and Django REST Framework (DRF).
Proficiency with relational databases SQL, PostgreSQL, and/or MySQL.
Understanding of RESTful API design principles and HTTP fundamentals.
Basic familiarity with AWS services, at minimum awareness of EC2 S3 and RDS.
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Strong debugging skills and attention to detail.
Nice to have:
Experience with task queues Celery, Redis, or similar.
Familiarity with Docker and containerized deployments.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, etc. ).
Basic knowledge of AWS Lambda or serverless patterns.
Prior experience building multi-tenant SaaS or B2B platforms.
Understanding of caching strategies (Redis, Memcached).
Tech Stack:
Language: Python 3 x.
Framework: Django, Django REST Framework.
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL.
Cloud: AWS (EC2 RDS, S3 Lambda).
Infrastructure: Docker (preferred), Nginx.
Version Control: Git / GitHub.
Others: Celery, Redis (preferred).

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
function: Frontend Development, Full-Stack Development, Other Software Development
skills: React, frontend, React.js, infrastructure, backend, TypeScript, AI
description_text:
Responsibilities:
Build AiStudio's next product surfaces: Your primary job is 0-to-1 product creation. Nothing is predefined. You work with your FDPM to find where the platform can be extended to solve problems no product currently solves, then design and ship it.
Own the full stack: Data model, services and APIs, the UI, the integrations, the infrastructure. One engineer carries a feature from an empty repository to a client using it in production.
Run what you ship: Delivery does not stop at launch. You own environments, releases, migrations, monitoring and the support that follows. When something breaks at a client, you diagnose it, fix it and make sure it does not recur. Lead deep discovery: Before you write code, go deep on the business. What is structurally broken, where the unsolved value sits, and what is buildable fastest. Pressure-test your hypotheses with the people who live with the outcome.
Be a technical partner to the C-suite: Earn trust with the executives accountable for outcomes, not just their technical teams. Explain what you are building, why it will work and where the risks are.
Scale what works and stay at the frontier: Make successful builds repeatable with the core R& D team, and feed what you learn in the field back into what AiStudio builds next.
Requirements:
2 to 6 years in technical roles, with a track record of shipping and running production software end to end across backend, front-end and infrastructure.
You think like a founder: Curious about the business, scrappy and resourceful, as comfortable in a strategic discussion with a CEO as you are deep in a codebase. You have shipped products real people use.
0-to-1 build track record: You have built production software from scratch in ambiguous environments and can point to something now used at scale.
Production AI experience: Prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks and deployment at scale. Not just prototypes.
Genuine full-stack depth: Backend services and APIs, data modelling and database work (Postgres, Supabase or equivalent), and modern front-end (TypeScript, React or similar) with the design judgment to build an interface an executive will use without a manual.
Deployment and operations ownership: Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, environments, secrets, logging and monitoring. You have kept live systems healthy, not just launched them.
Business acumen and customer instinct: You identify the real problem without being handed a brief, and build trust at every level of an organisation.
Builder's judgment: You know what is buildable, how long it takes and when to cut scope to get something real into production. Former technical founders are strongly encouraged to apply.

description_text:
We're looking for an AI engineer to own the loop that turns real-world patient interactions into better AI agents, from eval infrastructure to production-grade systems. You'll own the systems that make our agents smarter with every patient interaction, from the voice AI that activates patients and handles calls to insurance, vendors, and providers, to the autonomous workflows that orchestrate end-to-end care delivery. You'll work directly with the founders to build production systems that learn and improve from real-world usage. You'll design the eval pipelines, capture the right signals from product usage, and create the reinforcement learning loops that drive continuous quality improvement across every agent we ship. If you've built AI systems that get better with usage and want to apply that experience to healthcare, where every improvement directly impacts patient outcomes, we'd love to talk.
Responsibilities:
Launch and scale high-quality AI agents.
Build and deploy voice AI for automating patient activation and outbound calls to insurance, vendors, and providers.
Design individual agents that orchestrate end-to-end workflows such as DME delivery, prior authorisations, and care coordination.
Build copilots that assist and nudge advocates in real time.
Build the eval and reinforcement learning pipeline.
Set up the evaluation infrastructure that measures agent quality across every interaction.
Capture the right data from product usage, build the feedback loop, and implement RL pipelines so that agent performance improves continuously with real-world usage.
Create the usage-driven product improvement flywheel.
Scale AI Nurse by composing multiple agents.
Bring together voice, workflow, and copilot agents into a unified AI Nurse experience.
Ensure that as we scale, each agent reinforces the others through shared learning and a consistent improvement loop.
Ship fast and iterate with real users.
Deploy to production, monitor how agents perform with actual patients, and improve based on real conversations.
Own the tight loop from usage data to system-level improvements.
Shape the technical roadmap.
Work with the founders to decide what to build next.
Bring deep knowledge of what's possible with current AI capabilities and help us make smart bets on where the technology is heading.
Lay the foundation for scale.
Make architectural decisions that will hold up as we grow from hundreds of patients to hundreds of thousands.
Document systems, establish best practices, and build with the next engineer in mind.
Requirements:
You've built AI agents or LLM-powered systems from scratch and shipped them to production, not just demos, but systems handling real interactions with real users at scale.
You have hands-on experience building evaluation pipelines for AI systems, designing metrics, capturing signals from production usage, and using that data to systematically improve agent quality.
You have experience with reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), reward modelling, or other feedback-driven improvement loops for LLM-based systems.
You've monitored and debugged AI systems in production, you know what it takes to keep agents reliable when they're interacting with real people. You're comfortable with ambiguity.
The playbook doesn't exist yet, and you're excited to build it.
Nice to Have:
Experience in healthcare, health tech, or regulated industries (HIPAA, PHI handling).
Familiarity with Medicare, insurance workflows, or clinical operations.
Experience with voice AI systems, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and real-time voice orchestration.
Background in RAG systems, vector databases, and knowledge retrieval pipelines.
Contributions to open-source AI projects or a portfolio of side projects that show your range.
Good to Have:
Beyond technical skills, we're looking for someone who embodies the attributes that make great engineers at an early-stage company.
Proactive. You move quickly and take a forceful stand without being abrasive.
You act without being told what to do and bring new ideas to the company.
Analytically sharp. You structure and process qualitative or quantitative data and draw penetrating insights.
You learn quickly and absorb new information with ease.
High standards with attention to detail. You expect nothing short of the best from yourself and your team.
You don't let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
Passionate and open. You exhibit enthusiasm and a can-do attitude toward your work.
You solicit feedback often and react calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
